Fresh package, O3; benchmarks are diagnostic
Fresh package, O3; declared diagnostics, no execution

callables.scope: Native and library invocation; shared, mutable and single-use receivers.
callables.restrictions: Native ABI and owned-capture restrictions apply. Adapter diagnostics retain legacy exceptions.

combinators.scope: Eager collection transformations, effects, traversal and validation.
combinators.restrictions: Capability requirements and origin/error admission remain operation-specific; legacy native inference remains restricted.

functions.scope: Selected Pipeline, legacy Piped, composition, partial application and Kleisli.
functions.restrictions: Pipeline migration is tracked below. Partial binds plain positional prefixes of up to eight operands.

adt.scope: Algebraic choices and recursive data using native ownership.
adt.restrictions: Host qualification; device compilation does not establish GPU runtime support.

data.scope: Result, Optional integration, non-empty lists, Ior and Capture.
data.restrictions: Capture supports zero to two positional operands and homogeneous keyword packs. Legacy attempt has diagnostic restrictions.

iteration.scope: Lazy native adapters, branches, alignment, scans and consuming terminals.
iteration.restrictions: Lazy callbacks cannot raise; failures may be stored Result elements. Fallible source advancement and Resource scopes remain future contracts.

control.scope: Loops, state transitions and early termination.
control.restrictions: Native callback signatures and exact common raised errors remain part of admission.

algebra.scope: Family primitives, laws, shared traversal, sequential and accumulating policies.
algebra.restrictions: Public admission predicates are the generic extension contract. Audit coverage beyond Result/Validation and Ior remains a planned pass.

effects.scope: Reader, State, Writer and transformer capabilities.
effects.restrictions: Deferred computations retain callback borrows. Carrier stability and Writer identity restrictions remain documented.

matching.scope: Exhaustive value matching, guards and rewriting.
matching.restrictions: Up to sixteen noncapturing clauses and three subjects; matches borrow subjects and return owned values.

pipeline.name: Context
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the context; get extracts its carrier.

pipeline.name: Payload operations
pipeline.families: Functor; Filterable, Monad or FunctorFilter where required
pipeline.callbacks: Native closures and thin pointers; library callable contracts retain receiver modes.
pipeline.ownership: Transforms consume payloads; predicates and observers borrow them.
pipeline.errors: Exact family/callback error; stored errors retain their family.

pipeline.name: Whole-value stages
pipeline.families: Whole carrier; then selects its output Functor
pipeline.callbacks: Native or library callbacks; tap uses BorrowCallable.
pipeline.ownership: then consumes the carrier; tap borrows and retains it.

pipeline.name: Applicative combination
pipeline.callbacks: Native separate operands; library tuple/binary contracts. Stored n-ary thin pointers are owned and retain exact argument/result conventions.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes evaluated carriers; Cartesian output may require copies.
pipeline.errors: Family policy keeps or accumulates stored errors; native errors stay raised.

pipeline.name: Traversal
pipeline.families: Traversable source; Applicative target; filtering also requires FunctorFilter
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming transform or borrowing retention callback; single-use where the source permits.
pipeline.ownership: Original move-only values retained when the target does not duplicate them.
pipeline.errors: Source errors, target failures and raised errors stay distinct.
pipeline.timing: Selects target family; Reader defers callbacks and compaction.

pipeline.name: Traversal composition
pipeline.families: Traversable source with FunctorFilter for compaction or Monad for flattening; Applicative target
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming native or library callback; sequence uses Identity. Source and target determine repeatability.
pipeline.ownership: Move-only payloads survive compaction and flattening when the target does not duplicate them.
pipeline.errors: Source errors remain inside target effects; nested Result errors preserve the source family and origins.
pipeline.timing: Compaction and flattening run inside the target; source traversal retains its callback-construction timing.

pipeline.name: Discarded traversal
pipeline.families: Native iterator/owned iterable, or Result traversal; Applicative target
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming repeated transform for native sources; Result traversal can consume a single-use callback.
pipeline.ownership: Discards successful payloads without an output collection. Array inputs use safe temporary storage.
pipeline.errors: Source Result errors remain nested; target failures and native raised errors stay distinct.
pipeline.timing: Uses target loop timing for native sources and source traversal timing for Result.

pipeline.name: Effectful queries and reductions
pipeline.callbacks: Borrowing predicates; consuming unary/binary transformations; repeatable shared or mutable library receivers. Bind fold_effect(initial).run(step).
pipeline.ownership: Moves inputs, retains first matches and releases partial accumulators; Arrays use O(N) temporary List storage.
pipeline.errors: Exact native errors, stored target failures and borrowed origins remain distinct.
pipeline.timing: Target owns branch stopping and deferral; monoid identity is constructed before source binding.

pipeline.name: Result operations
pipeline.families: Result carriers; broader family capability admission still requires migration
pipeline.callbacks: Native closures or stored thin pointers, including mixed argument/result conventions; library callbacks retain their receiver and branch contracts.
pipeline.ownership: Runs the selected branch; handlers consume values while observers borrow.
pipeline.errors: Stored-error changes select a new ResultFamily; native raised errors retain their type.

pipeline.name: Pure reductions
pipeline.families: Native iterator and owned iterable sources; result selects its native family
pipeline.callbacks: Repeatable consuming projections or shared borrowing keys; stored native thin pointers supported
pipeline.ownership: Consume inputs; retain first extrema on ties and preserve result origins. Array uses shared temporary List conversion.
pipeline.errors: Exact callback or monoid errors; incompatible raised types reject at admission
pipeline.timing: Immediate ordered reduction; find_map stops without another pull, extrema evaluate each key once

pipeline.name: Structural conveniences
pipeline.families: Selected Functor, FunctorFilter, Monad or Applicative as required
pipeline.callbacks: ap consumes stored library callables; other methods use shared internal transforms
pipeline.ownership: Move source payloads; copied constants require Copyable. Branching application requires copyable operands.
pipeline.errors: Exact family and stored callable errors; source and target Result errors retain embedded origins
pipeline.timing: Family-owned ordering, accumulation and deferral; ap arguments are already evaluated

pipeline.name: Conditional factories
pipeline.families: Selected Monad with Bool payloads and matching branch payload/error types
pipeline.callbacks: Native zero-argument closures and thin pointers; single-use or repeatable library factories as required by the source
pipeline.ownership: Borrow native closures with exact origins; own thin pointers and library factories. Release skipped and abandoned captures.
pipeline.errors: Compatible exact native factory errors; stored Result errors remain in the carrier
pipeline.timing: Run only selected branches; absence/failure skips both. Family owns repeated calls and deferral.

pipeline.name: Accumulating policies
pipeline.families: Validation policy for native Results; n-ary methods retain the source family, traversal selects Result
pipeline.callbacks: Fixed native arities 1–8 or library tuple callables. Stored n-ary thin pointers are owned and retain exact argument/result conventions.
pipeline.ownership: Consume evaluated operands, callbacks and sources; release unvisited inputs and partial output on native failure
pipeline.errors: Stored errors accumulate through an inferred ListMonoid or explicit Semigroup; native raises stop immediately
pipeline.timing: Ordered synchronous accumulation; a single n-ary operand never invokes the error combiner
